title: BirdBrain Music Disc
description: This project adds a music disc of BirdBrain by Jamie Paige with a custom icon/item texture
body:
This Resource pack requires the companion DataPack to run correctly
https://modrinth.com/datapack/birdbrain-music-disc-datapack
To use this resource pack correctly run this command : /give @s minecraft:music_disc_13[minecraft:jukebox_playable={song:"birdbrain:birdbrain"},minecraft:custom_name='{"text":"BIRDBRAIN - Jamie Paige (ft. Kasane Teto)","italic":false}

I DO NOT OWN THE VIDEO IN THIS MOD, ALL RIGHTS GO TO JAMIE PAIGE
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCDsaRDKTCsGBJMUKx-KtukA
